nodes.text: Mission Control to survey vessel. Telemetry is green on our side. Confirm you are receiving.
Good. Your first survey site is flagged on the ship terminal. Check in when you find something.
We will boost the relay on our end. Your first survey site is flagged on the ship terminal.
Good morning, Captain. All ship systems are nominal. Would you like a summary of the excavation tools?
The scanner finds buried signals. The Sonic Excavator and Burster move soil fast; the Ultrasonic Brush and the excavator's Fine focus expose finds safely. Hold Tab for the tool wheel.
Your discovery just came through on the uplink. Nice work. Log anything unusual.
